create_clip_encoder: create a ClipEncoder instance using a pretrained CLIP model path and target device
get_text_embeddings: get text embeddings from a prompt string or list of prompts using the ClipEncoder
get_image_embeddings: get image embeddings from a batch of images using the ClipEncoder vision encoder
cache_empty_text_embeds: enable or disable caching of empty text embeddings in the ClipEncoder constructor
review_clip_encoder_class: review the ClipEncoder class and its text and image embedding methods
